column1: # eurlc-wgs -- typical genome sizes (bp), used when a species has no
# Lines starting with # are comments. A species line wins over a genus line.
# Values are rounded typical sizes of complete genomes (NCBI RefSeq), meant
# for coverage estimates (+-10 % is fine for that), not as reference values.
# Local additions or corrections: put a file with the same format in the
# database folder as genome_sizes.tsv -- its entries take precedence.
